Guidance & outlook: As of 30 th June, 2026, our outstanding order book stood at INR13,245 crores, reflecting our robust 103% year-on-year growth and providing us with a strong multi-year revenue visibility of our to tal order book, within-g roup projects account for approximately 70%, while external projects contribute to remaining 30%.
Despite these industry-wide challenges, PSP delivered a strong 65% year-on- year revenue growth during Q1FY27.
Increase in depreciation from INR17 crores to INR26 crores is mainly attributable to additions in asset block during FY26 as well as in Q1FY27.
Growth & demand: During the quarter, the company successfully completed six projects and receiving order inflows of INR630 crores, with 93% order from Adani Group.
The order book is diversified, with industrial projects comprising of 39%, resid ential projects 37%, government projects 23%, and institutional project approximately 1%.
The bid pipeline is INR6,200 plus crores with 61% group projects and 39% external projects.
Margins & costs: PSP Projects Limited July 30, 2026 EBITDA for the quarter is at INR55 crores versus INR25 crores, increased by 121% on YoY basis.

During the quarter under review, employee costs increased from INR35 crores to INR46 crores, which is mainly on account of annual increments processed in April month and increase in number of employees from 2,400 almost to 2,600.
So at EBITDA level, you can consider cost-plus formula works at 7% at EBITDA.
Capex & expansion: During Q1FY27, company has incurred capex of INR28 crores.
And the capex also the similar 3%-4% of revenue, so in this quarter we have done INR28 odd crores.
So, throughout the year, Precast plant capacity is, in the range of INR200 crores, so we'll be executing about INR150 crores to INR200 crores throughout the year whatever may be the project.
Balance sheet & cash: So, we have utilized less working capital facilities, and we have surplus FDs also.
I don't know what the positive direction in that is, but yes, they have contacted me to come and meet for that receivables.
Risks & challenges: The first quarter is traditionally a challenging period for the construction industry due to seasonal factors, including labor migration during festivals and wedding season, as well as the initial onset of monsoon.

guidance.t: I think as we have already told you that we'll be in focus, we'll be expecting some INR5,000 crores to INR6,000 crores of order book.

Guidance & outlook: During Q4FY26, the revenue from operations increased by 66% year-on-year to INR1,115 crores, driven by accelerated progress across institutional, industrial, residential, and government projects.
For the full year FY26, revenue from operations grew by 25% year-on-year to INR3,149 crores.
So at let's say next year FY2027 we will be doing INR4,500 crores and maybe then 20%- 25% so maybe a close to a INR5,700 crores revenue in FY2028.
Growth & demand: EBITDA for the quarter grew by 85% year-on-year to INR60 crores, while PAT grew sharply by 244% year-on-year to INR21 crores, demonstrating operating leverage as execution intensity picked up.
As of 31st March 2026, our outstanding order book stood at INR13,447 crores, 85% year- on-year growth providing strong multi-year revenue visibility.

Highest ever order inflow during FY26 were INR10,925 crores with 85% order from Adani - development work at SVPI Airport Ahmedabad, - Matunga Rehab Building Mumbai, - development of extended temple precinct area of Shri Ambaji Mata Temple, District Banaskantha.
Margins & costs: EBITDA stood at INR189 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6%.
But my question is that earlier, I mean, before Adani project started, we used to make 10%, 11%, 12% EBITDA margin and our PAT margin used to be 5%, 6%.

But even at 7.5%, 8% EBITDA margin, can we improve net profit margin to the extent of 4%, 5% by managing our interest cost because we don't have to pay interest on advances from Adani PSP Projects Limited April 30, 2026 project, so maybe, we can save on that front.
Capex & expansion: During Q4FY26, company has incurred capex of INR40 crores and year-to-date capex addition is INR192 crores.
